    while True:

import smbus2
import time

bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# MPU6050 registers
PWR_MGMT_1   = 0x6B
SMPLRT_DIV   = 0x19
CONFIG       = 0x1A
GYRO_CONFIG  = 0x1B
INT_ENABLE   = 0x38
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
GYRO_XOUT_H  = 0x43
GYRO_YOUT_H  = 0x45
GYRO_ZOUT_H  = 0x47

# MPU6050 power management
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, PWR_MGMT_1, 0)

# MPU6050 sampling rate
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, SMPLRT_DIV, 7)

# MPU6050 configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, CONFIG, 0)

# MPU6050 gyro configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, GYRO_CONFIG, 24)

# MPU6050 interrupt enable
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, INT_ENABLE, 1)

# Read accelerometer and gyroscope data
def read_accel_gyro():
    accel_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_XOUT_H, 2)
    accel_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_YOUT_H, 2)
    accel_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_ZOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_XOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_YOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_ZOUT_H, 2)

    # Convert the data
    accel_x_scaled = (accel_x[0] << 8 | accel_x[1]) / 16384.0
    accel_y_scaled = (accel_y[0] << 8 | accel_y[1]) / 16384.0
    accel_z_scaled = (accel_z[0] << 8 | accel_z[1]) / 16384.0
    gyro_x_scaled = (gyro_x[0] << 8 | gyro_x[1]) / 131.0
    gyro_y_scaled = (gyro_y[0] << 8 | gyro_y[1]) / 131.0
    gyro_z_scaled = (gyro_z[0] << 8 | gyro_z[1]) / 131.0

    return accel_x_scaled, accel_y_scaled, accel_z_scaled, gyro_x_scaled, gyro_y_scaled, gyro_z_scaled

# Read accelerometer and gyroscope data
accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z = read_accel_gyro()

# Print the data
print("Accelerometer data:")
print("X-axis: {:.2f} g".format(accel_x))
print("Y-axis: {:.2f} g".format(accel_y))
print("Z-axis: {:.2f} g".format(accel_z))
print("Gyroscope data:")
print("X-axis: {:.2f} °/s".format(gyro_x))
print("Y-axis: {:.2f} °/s".format(gyro_y))
print("Z-axis: {:.2f} °/s".format(gyro_z))

height = disp.height

    cmd = "df -h | awk '$NF==\"/\"{printf \"Disk: %d/%dGB %s\", $3,$2,$5}'"
    Disk = str(subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True))

import smbus2
import time

# Get I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Select control register, 0x00(00) with command register, 0x80(128)
#		0x03(03)	Power ON mode
bus.write_byte_data(0x39, 0x00 | 0x80, 0x03)
# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Select timing register, 0x01(01) with command register, 0x80(128)
#		0x02(02)	Nominal integration time = 402ms
bus.write_byte_data(0x39, 0x01 | 0x80, 0x02)

time.sleep(0.5)

# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Read data back from 0x0C(12) with command register, 0x80(128), 2 bytes
# ch0 LSB, ch0 MSB
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x39, 0x0C | 0x80, 2)

# Convert the data
ch0 = data[1] * 256 + data[0]

# Output data to screen
print("Full Spectrum(IR + Visible) :%d lux" %ch0)

# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Read data back from 0x0E(14) with command register, 0x80(128), 2 bytes
# ch1 LSB, ch1 MSB
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x39, 0x0E | 0x80, 2)

# Convert the data
ch1 = data[1] * 256 + data[0]

# Output data to screen
print("Infrared Value :%d lux" %ch1)

# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Select ID register, 0x0A(10) with command register, 0x80(128)
#		0x04(04)	Manufacturer ID = Taos
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x39, 0x0A | 0x80, 1)

#		0x00(00)	Part ID = TSL2561
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x39, 0x0B | 0x80, 1)

import smbus2

bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# MPU6050 registers
PWR_MGMT_1   = 0x6B
SMPLRT_DIV   = 0x19
CONFIG       = 0x1A
GYRO_CONFIG  = 0x1B
ACCEL_CONFIG = 0x1C
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
GYRO_XOUT_H  = 0x43
GYRO_YOUT_H  = 0x45
GYRO_ZOUT_H  = 0x47

# MPU6050 power management
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, PWR_MGMT_1, 0)

# MPU6050 sampling rate
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, SMPLRT_DIV, 7)

# MPU6050 configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, CONFIG, 0)

# MPU6050 gyro configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, GYRO_CONFIG, 24)

# MPU6050 accelerometer configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, ACCEL_CONFIG, 0)

# Read 3 accelerometer readings
for i in range(3):
    # Read accelerometer
    accel_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_XOUT_H, 2)
    accel_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_YOUT_H, 2)
    accel_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_ZOUT_H, 2)

    # Read gyroscope
    gyro_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_XOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_YOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_ZOUT_H, 2)

    # Format accelerometer readings
    accel_x_out = (accel_x[0] << 8) | accel_x[1]
    accel_y_out = (accel_y[0] << 8) | accel_y[1]
    accel_z_out = (accel_z[0] << 8) | accel_z[1]

    # Format gyroscope readings
    gyro_x_out = (gyro_x[0] << 8) | gyro_x[1]
    gyro_y_out = (gyro_y[0] << 8) | gyro_y[1]
    gyro_z_out = (gyro_z[0] << 8) | gyro_z[1]

    # Print readings
    print("Accelerometer: x =", accel_x_out, "y =", accel_y_out, "z =", accel_z_out)
    print("Gyroscope: x =", gyro_x_out, "y =", gyro_y_out, "z =", gyro_z_out)

    # Wait 0.1 seconds

import smbus2
import time

# Get I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# TCS34725 address, 0x29(41)
# Select enable register, 0x00(00)
#		0x03(03)	Power ON, RGBC ON
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x00, 0x03)
# TCS34725 address, 0x29(41)
# Select ALS time register, 0x01(01)
#		0x00(00)	2.4ms
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x01, 0x00)
# TCS34725 address, 0x29(41)
# Select wait time register, 0x03(03)
#		0xFF(255)	Wait time = 2.4ms + 255 * 2.4ms = 614.4ms
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x03, 0xFF)

while True:
	# TCS34725 address, 0x29(41)
	# Read data back from 0x14(20), 4 bytes
	# ch0 HB, ch0 LB, ch1 HB, ch1 LB
	data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x29, 0x14, 4)

	# Convert the data
	ch0 = data[1] * 256 + data[0]
	ch1 = data[3] * 256 + data[2]

	# Output data to screen
	print("Red Color: {0} \tGreen Color: {1} \tBlue Color: {2}".format(ch0, ch1, ch0-ch1))
	time.sleep(1)

from time import sleep

led2 = LED(21)

    led.on()
    led2.on()

    led.off()
    led2.off()
    print("LED off")

prompt: Write a Python program for a Raspberry Pi that samples an analog channel from an ADS1115 through an ADC at address 0x48 using adafruit-circuitpython-ads1x15. Print each reading to standard output. Run once and exit. The program must release the hardware on exit, including on interrupt.
code:
import time
import board
import busio
import adafruit_ads1x15.ads1115 as ADS
from adafruit_ads1x15.analog_in import AnalogIn

# Create the I2C bus
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)

# Create the ADC object using the I2C bus
ads = ADS.ADS1115(i2c)

# Create single-ended input on channel 0
chan = AnalogIn(ads, ADS.P0)

# Print the ADC value every second
while True:
    print('{:>5}\t{:>5.3f}'.format(chan.value, chan.voltage))
    time.sleep(1)

import smbus2
import time

# Open I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# VL53L0X address, 0x29(41)
# Select control register, 0x00(00)
#		0x01(01)	Start ranging
bus.write_byte(0x29, 0x00)

# VL53L0X address, 0x29(41)
# Select range register, 0x14(20)
#		0x03(03)	Preset mode
bus.write_byte(0x29, 0x14)

# VL53L0X address, 0x29(41)
# Select range register, 0x14(20)
#		0x02(02)	Long range mode
bus.write_byte(0x29, 0x14)

# VL53L0X address, 0x29(41)
# Select control register, 0x00(00)
#		0x01(01)	Start ranging
bus.write_byte(0x29, 0x00)

while True:
	try:
		# VL53L0X address, 0x29(41)
		# Read data back from 0x01(01), 2 bytes
		# status register, distance MSB, distance LSB
		data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x29, 0x01, 2)

		# Convert the data
		distance = data[0] * 256 + data[1]

		# Output data to screen
		print("Distance in cm: ", distance)
		time.sleep(0.1)

	except KeyboardInterrupt:
		print("Program interrupted")
		break

# Close I2C bus
bus.close()

import smbus2
import time

# Get I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Select control register, 0x00(00)
#		0x03(03)	Power ON mode
bus.write_byte_data(0x39, 0x00, 0x03)
# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
# Select timing register, 0x01(01)
#		0x02(02)	Nominal integration time = 402ms
bus.write_byte_data(0x39, 0x01, 0x02)

while True:
	try:
		# TSL2561 address, 0x39(57)
		# Read data back from 0x0C(12) with command register, 0x80(128), 2 bytes
		# ch0 LSB, ch0 MSB
		data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x39, 0x80, 2)

		# Convert the data
		ch0 = data[1] * 256 + data[0]
		ch1 = data[3] * 256 + data[2]

		# Output data to screen
		print("Full Spectrum(IR + Visible) :%d lux" %ch0)
		print("Infrared Value :%d lux" %ch1)
		print("Visible Value :%d lux" % (ch0 - ch1))
		time.sleep(1)

	except KeyboardInterrupt:
		print("Program interrupted")
		break

# Close I2C connection
bus.close()

# 0x05(05) = Configuration Register

# Convert the data
config = data[0] * 256 + data[1]

# INA219 address, 0x40(64)
# Read 2 bytes from register 0x06(06)
# 0x06(06) = Shunt Voltage Register
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x40, 0x06, 2)

# Convert the data
shuntvoltage = data[0] * 256 + data[1]

# Read 2 bytes from register 0x07(07)
# 0x07(07) = Bus Voltage Register

# Convert the data
current = data[0] * 256 + data[1]

# INA219 address, 0x40(64)
# Read 2 bytes from register 0x0A(0A)
# 0x0A(0A) = Calibration Register

# Convert the data

# Output data to screen

print "Die ID : %d" %die_id

print "Current : %d mA" %current

import smbus2
import time

bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# MPU6050 registers
PWR_MGMT_1   = 0x6B
SMPLRT_DIV   = 0x19
CONFIG       = 0x1A
GYRO_CONFIG  = 0x1B
ACCEL_CONFIG = 0x1C
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
GYRO_XOUT_H  = 0x43
GYRO_YOUT_H  = 0x45
GYRO_ZOUT_H  = 0x47

# MPU6050 power management
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, PWR_MGMT_1, 0)

# MPU6050 sampling rate
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, SMPLRT_DIV, 7)

# MPU6050 configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, CONFIG, 0)

# MPU6050 gyro configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, GYRO_CONFIG, 24)

# MPU6050 accelerometer configuration
bus.write_byte_data(0x68, ACCEL_CONFIG, 0)

# Read 8 samples
for i in range(8):
    # Read accelerometer
    accel_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_XOUT_H, 2)
    accel_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_YOUT_H, 2)
    accel_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, ACCEL_ZOUT_H, 2)

    # Read gyroscope
    gyro_x = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_XOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_y = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_YOUT_H, 2)
    gyro_z = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x68, GYRO_ZOUT_H, 2)

    # Convert to signed 16-bit integer
    accel_x = (accel_x[0] << 8) | accel_x[1]
    accel_y = (accel_y[0] << 8) | accel_y[1]
    accel_z = (accel_z[0] << 8) | accel_z[1]
    gyro_x = (gyro_x[0] << 8) | gyro_x[1]
    gyro_y = (gyro_y[0] << 8) | gyro_y[1]
    gyro_z = (gyro_z[0] << 8) | gyro_z[1]

    # Print
    print(f"Accelerometer: {accel_x}, {accel_y}, {accel_z}")
    print(f"Gyroscope: {gyro_x}, {gyro_y}, {gyro_z}")

    # Wait 0.1 seconds
    time.sleep(0.1)

import smbus2

# Get I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# TSL2591 address, 0x29(41)
# Select enable register, 0x00(00)
#		0x01(01)	Power ON
#		0x00(00)	Power OFF
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x00, 0x01)
# TSL2591 address, 0x29(41)
# Select ALS time register, 0x01(01)
#		0x02(02)	100ms
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x01, 0x02)
# TSL2591 address, 0x29(41)
# Select ALS gain register, 0x10(16)
#		0x00(00)	Low gain (1x)
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x10, 0x00)

time.sleep(0.5)

# TSL2591 address, 0x29(41)
# Read data back from 0x14(20), 2 bytes
# ch0 LSB, ch0 MSB
data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x29, 0x14, 2)

# Convert the data
ch0 = data[1] * 256 + data[0]

# Output data to screen
print("Full Spectrum(IR + Visible) :%d lux" %ch0)

# TSL2591 address, 0x29(41)
# Select enable register, 0x00(00)
#		0x01(01)	Power ON
#		0x00(00)	Power OFF
bus.write_byte_data(0x29, 0x00, 0x00)

import smbus2
import time

bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

try:
    while True:
        data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(0x1d, 0x32, 6)
        x = data[0] | (data[1] << 8)
        if x & (1 << 16 - 1):
            x = x - (1 << 16)
        y = data[2] | (data[3] << 8)
        if y & (1 << 16 - 1):
            y = y - (1 << 16)
        z = data[4] | (data[5] << 8)
        if z & (1 << 16 - 1):
            z = z - (1 << 16)
        print(x, y, z)
        time.sleep(1)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pass
finally:
    bus.close()

code:
import sys
import time
import board
import adafruit_dht

# Initialise the DHT device, with data pin connected to:
dhtDevice = adafruit_dht.DHT22(board.D4)

# Main loop
for i in range(3):
    try:
        # Print the values to the serial port
        temperature_c = dhtDevice.temperature
        temperature_f = temperature_c * (9 / 5) + 32
        humidity = dhtDevice.humidity
        print(
            "Temp: {:.1f} F / {:.1f} C    Humidity: {}% ".format(
                temperature_f, temperature_c, humidity
            )
        )

        # Wait 2 seconds before continuing
        time.sleep(2.0)
    except RuntimeError as error:
        # Errors happen fairly often, DHT's are hard to read, just keep going
        print(error.args[0])
        time.sleep(2.0)
        continue
    except Exception as error:
        dhtDevice.exit()
        raise error

# Release the hardware
dhtDevice.exit()
